rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: NetIntel provides network intelligence tools covering DNS lookups, SSL certificate analysis, WHOIS queries, email security checks (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and OSINT operations. The server uses x402 micropayment protocol requiring an EVM wallet with USDC on Base mainnet for pay-per-call access.
